location_description: Montville is a town in New London County, Connecticut in the United States. The population was 18,387 at the 2020 census.The villages of Chesterfield, Mohegan, Oakdale, and Uncasville are located within the town; the latter two have their own ZIP Codes. Town residents often identify with these villages more than the Town of Montville as a whole.
